## Outcome

What should a user or contributor be able to do when this is complete?

## Ownership and dependencies

Identify the owner, affected paths and related issues or pull requests. Link the consumer issue for cross-repository work.

## Completion check

Describe the observable result, test command and any platform or package required. On handoff, record the current revision, remaining work and next owner.
